# Everyday command lines that carry a value through a variable — the
# carried-value half of the false-positive sweep (sweep_test.go,
# iss-2609281134544802, ruling AT).
#
# Each line is ordinary work and should allow: a pid the caller recorded, a
# program named by a variable, a script or a command a script built up. The
# first block uses a variable the line did not set, which the guard reads as
# it always has; the second sets it on the same line, which the carried-value
# reading follows. A block or warn on any line here is a false positive the
# sweep's ceiling counts.

# --- set before the line ran -------------------------------------------------
kill "$pid"
kill -TERM "$PID"
kill -- -"$pg"
kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null
kill $(cat run.pid)
"$GO" build ./...
"$GO" test ./internal/...
exec "$BIN" "$@"
$EDITOR notes.md
bash "$SCRIPT"
source "$ENV_FILE"
eval "$cmd"
sh -c "$cmd"
git push origin "$branch"
git checkout "$BRANCH"
gh pr view "$PR"
go run ./cmd/abcd capture "$TITLE"
curl -fsS "$URL" -o "$OUT"
ps -o pid= -p "$pid" | xargs kill

# --- set on the same line ----------------------------------------------------
sleep 30 & pid=$!; kill "$pid"
pid=$!; kill -TERM "$pid"
pid=$(cat run.pid); kill "$pid"
pg=$(ps -o pgid= -p "$pid" | tr -d ' '); kill -- -"$pg"
GO=go; "$GO" build ./...
GO=$(command -v go); "$GO" version
BIN=./bin/abcd-darwin-arm64; "$BIN" --version
P=make; $P build
cmd="go test ./..."; eval "$cmd"
cmd="make build"; sh -c "$cmd"
msg="hello"; bash -c "echo $msg"
S=scripts/check-vcs-stamp.sh; bash "$S"
out=$(mktemp); go test ./... > "$out"; cat "$out"
branch=$(git branch --show-current); git push origin "$branch"
root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); cd "$root" && make build
dir=$(mktemp -d); rm -rf "$dir"
TMP=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$TMP"' EXIT
n=$(wc -l < notes.txt); echo "$n"
PORT=8080; curl "http://localhost:$PORT/health"
f=notes.md; $EDITOR "$f"
for f in *.go; do gofmt -l "$f"; done
for pid in $(cat pids); do kill "$pid"; done
while read -r line; do echo "$line"; done < notes.txt
git log --oneline | while read -r sha msg; do echo "$sha $msg"; done
ps -o pid= -p 4242 | xargs kill
pgrep -l make > procs.txt; cat procs.txt
lsof -i :8080 > holders.txt; cat holders.txt
X='echo hi'; eval "$X"

# --- a bare-name source in a directory the line does not fix -----------------
cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && source .envrc
cd "$(mktemp -d)" && source setup.sh
pushd "$(dirname "$0")" && source env.sh && popd
